mapper.select: /* selectByAccommodation */ SELECT ta.* , tu.user_id as manager_user_id , tu.nm as manager_nm , tu.role as manager_role , tu.email as manager_email , tu.phone as manager_phone FROM tb_accommodation ta INNER JOIN tb_user tu on tu.user_id = ta.manager_id WHERE ta.idx = #{value}

/* selectByAllAccommodation */ SELECT ta.* , tu.user_id as manager_user_id , tu.nm as manager_nm , tu.role as manager_role , tu.email as manager_email , tu.phone as manager_phone FROM tb_accommodation ta INNER JOIN tb_user tu on tu.user_id = ta.manager_id ORDER BY ta.created_at desc
